effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Classwise reservoir at 200/class replaces official global reservoir; objective and two independent memory minibatches retained; shared class-balanced CE and Adam/MLP protocol
effective_config.derpp_coefficient_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aimagelab/mammoth/e75a491c69fd729edeb01431afb753d9157d9a81/models/config/derpp.yaml (seq-cifar100, buffer500); transferred fixed coefficients, not NIDS-tuned

policies.access: Only task3 current training rows and checkpoint002 resident memory are optimizer/retrieval inputs. No old training pool revisit, new memory selection, hidden probe buffer, or holdout/test retrieval.
policies.arms: random: original random Replay; mir: protection-off ablation; mir_rare_ce: MIR+mean rare-row CE; mir_rare_margin: MIR+mean softplus(zNormal-zTrue). Base loss is unchanged minibatch-class-balanced CE.
policies.cost: Equal real steps, batch/class counts, current exposure and memory capacity, NOT equal FLOPs or total forward/backward sample touches. Virtual optimization, candidate scoring, real optimization, trace, serialization and final evaluation are reported separately.
policies.mir: Classwise candidate set contains baseline random replay IDs plus random other resident IDs; size=min(class memory,max(100,class quota)). Rank raw per-row CE increase after a copied current-only minibatch-class-balanced-CE Adam step with copied optimizer state. No real current-only step. This is quota-matched Adam-lookahead MIR, not original SGD MIR.
policies.rare: Current-task non-Normal classes with original prepared training count<200. Same current minibatch rare rows; no oversampling. Extra weight1, no search. Empty rare minibatches add zero.
policies.resume: Same-identity progress checkpoints every50 steps include real Adam state and audit chains. Resume replays only the deterministic index schedule to the saved boundary; successful real steps are not repeated. Work after the last durable boundary is failed-attempt overhead, not a new scientific replicate.
policies.scale: Equal coefficient does not imply equal loss/parameter-gradient scale. Analytic extra-loss logit-gradient L2 proxies are recorded; they are not parameter gradients or a causal scale-matching guarantee.
policies.schedule: Historical current+memory shuffled index schedule, batch256, eight epochs with minimum2000 steps; full pilot requires exactly2000 steps. Current IDs and per-step per-class quotas are preserved in every arm.
policies.scope: Exploratory task3 new-class learning diagnostic; not old-class forgetting, novelty, or completion of RQ1/RQ3.
policies.start: One verified historical S2000 Replay checkpoint002 per dataset/seed; model and resident memory identical across arms. Original prefix provenance is retained, not relabelled as new-source training.
policies.trace: Step0 and every50 steps: fixed current rare rows and fixed resident memory only; diagnostic forwards never affect selection. No test feedback. Test inference occurs only at the final checkpoint, with an explicit exploratory label.
